name: Akagi Gang
summary: The Akagi Gang is a group of people from the Land of Tea.

name: Allied Mothers Force
summary: The Allied Mothers Force is an age-old Konohagakure team made up solely of all the mothers in the village. During wartime, they would protect the village and those left within it until their loved ones returned from war. On one occasion, the current generation of this organisation was able to prevent the Sumo Wrestlers from attacking the village during the Fourth Shinobi World War.

name: Ame Orphans
summary: The Ame Orphans were three children who lost their parents due to Amegakure's involvement in the Second Shinobi World War.

debut.ova: Naruto Shippūden: UNSG anime cutscenes

name: Analysis Team
summary: The Analysis Team is a team from the Konohagakure Intelligence Division who work closely with the Konoha Torture and Interrogation Force to extract information from their detainees. This division was headed by Inoichi Yamanaka.

name: A–B Combo
summary: The A–B Combo, renowned as the Strongest Tag-Team, is a sibling team from Kumogakure. It consists of A — the son of the Third Raikage — and Killer B who is recognised as A's brother, after he successfully beheaded a training dummy during a selection process.

name: Bikōchū Search Team
summary: The Bikōchū Search Team was a genin team, assigned to locate the rare bikōchū beetle, which could track any target as long as it had the target's scent, in hopes of locating Sasuke Uchiha.

name: Byakuya Gang
summary: The Byakuya Gang was a group of owl-masked thieves formed by Gekkō who stole from the rich and then sold the goods, in an effort to distribute the proceeds to the poor in remote areas, leading to them being regarded as noble thieves.

name: Communications Team
summary: Within each division of the Allied Shinobi Forces, there was a team of shinobi with the express purpose of ensuring that contact is maintained between individuals found throughout the alliance, so that vital information may be relayed both quickly and securely across vast distances. This task is seemingly achieved by working in tandem with the Intelligence Division, or more specifically its captain Inoichi Yamanaka, whose telepathy makes such communication seemingly possible.

name: Counter-Terrorism Division
summary: The Counter-Terrorism Division is a team of chūnin and jōnin-level shinobi of Sunagakure led by Kankurō, tasked with locating and arresting wanted criminals, who are listed in the Bingo Book.

debut.novel: Gaara Hiden: A Sandstorm Mirage

name: Cypher Division
summary: The Cypher Division or Intel Cypher Division was Kirigakure's secret intelligence squad. Kisame Hoshigaki was assigned by Fuguki Suikazan to be the squad's bodyguard, as well as protecting the codes they were carrying. When the group was cornered by Ibiki Morino, a master interrogator, Kisame remembered that his superior had stressed that the codes were far more important than the lives of any member of the group, and resolved to slaughter all of his comrades, to prevent the codes from falling into the wrong hands.

name: Daimyō Protection Squad
summary: This squad was created to protect a range of daimyō from being taken by Akatsuki during the Fourth Shinobi World War.

name: Dark Thunder Group
summary: The Dark Thunder Group is a group of predominately missing-nin that exclusively pursues the vendettas of its members.

debut.novel: Sasuke Shinden: Book of Sunrise

name: Demon Brothers
summary: The Demon Brothers, Gōzu and Meizu, are two chūnin from Kirigakure that assisted Zabuza Momochi in defecting from the village. They subsequently worked with Zabuza in assassinations to earn enough funds for a second attempt at the Mizukage's life.

debut.novel: Naruto: Innocent Heart, Demonic Blood

name: Dotō's Three-Man-Team
summary: This was a squad of Yukigakure ninja who had been hired by Dotō Kazahana to kill the Land of Snow's heiress, Koyuki Kazahana. All three of them used special Chakra Armours, and Nadare along with Fubuki were experts with Ice Release techniques, which involves manipulating preexisting ice as opposed to actually creating them. They died fighting Team 7.

debut.movie: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow

name: Eight Man Squad
summary: This was a team formed after news of Sasuke Uchiha's victory over Orochimaru reached Konoha. Upon realising that Sasuke still wouldn't be coming back to the village, Naruto asked the Fifth Hokage to send a squad out to hunt down Itachi Uchiha, in hopes that finding him will mean they'd find Sasuke as he'd be targeting him. Kakashi added that a small but elite squad of shinobi would be needed to take down a member of Akatsuki, and enlisted the members of Team Kurenai for their tracking skills. With this, Team Kakashi and Team Kurenai formed an eight man squad to hunt down the Uchiha.

debut.game: Naruto Shippūden: Ultimate Ninja Storm Generations
debut.ova: Naruto Shippūden: UNSG anime cutscenes

name: Eight-Tails Subduing Team
summary: The Third Raikage's rule was noted to be riddled with the jinchūriki of the Eight-Tails losing control of the beast, and going on a rampage. To deal with these epidemics, the Third assembled a special team tasked with restraining the Eight-Tails whenever this happened. They would bind the Eight-Tails with chains — which in the anime, were said to be imbued with a fūinjutsu — and distract it, giving the Third enough time to use the Kohaku no Jōhei to seal the beast. The inability of jinchūriki to control the Eight-Tails cost Kumogakure many lives, including that of Furui who was a member of the team. After the Eight-Tails was sealed into Killer B, he was able to control it, bringing an end to the rampages and the assumed disbanding of this team.

name: Enlightened Ones
summary: The Enlightened Ones are a faction of former shinobi who left their hidden village in order to join the revolutionary Gengo following the aftermath of the Fourth Shinobi World War. They were primarily made up of young, single men but they were willing to accept women into their group. Like the Akatsuki, they are dissatisfied with the current system of shinobi; they seek to replace the current ruling class of normal people and put shinobi in control of the world.

debut.novel: Shikamaru Hiden: A Cloud Drifting in Silent Darkness

name: Escort Unit
summary: The Escort Unit was an elite team under the leadership of the Second Hokage— Tobirama Senju. Along with the members of Team Tobirama: Hiruzen Sarutobi, Koharu Utatane and Homura Mitokado, the unit included Danzō Shimura, Kagami Uchiha, and Torifu Akimichi.

name: Exploding-Till-You-Eat
summary: Exploding-Till-You-Eat is a father and son (Kūi and Daore) team of competitive eaters who travel the land participating in any and all eating contests. To most onlookers, their team's name makes no sense, as the common expression is "eating-till-you-explode". Kūi and Daore dislike the common expression, and whenever somebody brings it up they do not acknowledge it.

debut.novel: Naruto Shinden: Parent and Child Day

name: Explosion Corps
summary: The Explosion Corps is an organisation from Iwagakure. Not much is known about this organisation other than the only known members are Gari and Deidara, both of whom were capable of using the Explosion Release kekkei genkai.

name: Fifth Division
summary: The Fifth Division, also known as the Special Battle Division, was a battalion in the Allied Shinobi Forces, formed in preparation of the Fourth Shinobi World War. It is led by the Land of Iron's leader, Mifune.

name: First Division
summary: The First Division, also known as the Mid-Range Battle Division, was a battalion in the Allied Shinobi Forces led by Darui of Kumogakure, formed in preparation for the Fourth Shinobi World War.

name: Five Great Countries' Joint Investigation Team

names.english: Five Great Countries' Joint Investigation Team
names.kanji: 五大国による合同捜査チーム
names.romaji: Godaikoku ni yoru Gōdō Sōsa Chīmu

summary: The Five Great Countries' Joint Investigation Team is a team consisting of shinobi of the Five Great Shinobi Countries to investigate major threats.

name: Four Celestial Symbols Men
summary: The Four Celestial Symbols Men were a group of shinobi from the Takumi Village.

name: Four Ninja Animal Warriors
summary: The Four Ninja Animal Warriors were a group of Konohagakure ninja animals led by Condor. The team consists of Condor, two Boxing Kangaroos and a Giant Anteater. All the animals possessed amazing taijutsu skills and were able to cause the Konoha ninja, Naruto Uzumaki, Rock Lee, Shino Aburame and team leader, Kotetsu Hagane struggling in their fights against them. In the end, all the members were defeated and Condor was captured by the Konoha ninja. It is unknown if the kangaroos or the anteater possessed the ability to speak like Condor.

name: Fourth Division
summary: The Fourth Division, also known as the Long-Range Battle Division, was a battalion in the Allied Shinobi Forces led by Gaara of Sunagakure, formed in preparation for the Fourth Shinobi World War.

name: Furido's 4-Man Team
summary: A team led by Kazuma, who during the time beared the alias Furido, was formed to try to once again overthrow the Hokage, believing that the Land of Fire should have only one head of state, the daimyō. Kazuma resurrected four lightning-chakra users from the Twelve Guardian Ninja, intending to use Limelight to destroy Konoha. When one of the four resurrected was defeated, he released the others and tried to use his son, but that failed as well. All members of the team were ultimately killed by Konoha-nin.

name: Gang of Four
summary: The Gang of Four were a group of four shinobi, who served under Yomi and appeared in Naruto Shippūden the Movie. Setsuna acted as leader under Yomi.

name: Garakuta Gang
summary: The Garakuta Gang are regarded as a group of deadbeat shinobi that target antique art pieces.

name: Gatō Company

images.caption: The thugs hired by Gatō on behalf of the company.

summary: The Gatō Company is the shipping company formerly operated by Gatō, using his import/export as a front to make his fortune as a smuggler of illegal goods and selling drugs. Gatō had become the richest man in the world as a result, and went to great lengths to protect his interests through blackmail and murder. The majority of his subordinates are thugs and mercenaries, including his bodyguards Zōri and Waraji, who did Gatō's bidding to ensure Land of Waves remained under his control by crushing any resistance.

debut.novel: Naruto: Innocent Heart, Demonic Blood

name: Genbu Shinobi Trio
summary: The Genbu Shinobi Trio is a genin team from Iwagakure who participate in the Chūnin Exams at Konohagakure.

name: Ghost Army
summary: The Ghost Army was a brigade of moving stone soldiers that served the demon Mōryō. Being made of stone and seemingly to move on a ghostly will, they are invulnerable to conventional weapons and immensely difficult to stop.

name: Gold and Silver Brothers
summary: The Gold and Silver Brothers, also known as the "Two Lights", were two infamous shinobi from Kumogakure, that were distantly related to the Sage of Six Paths.

debut.novel: Sakura Hiden: Thoughts of Love, Riding Upon a Spring Breeze (Mentioned)

name: Haido's Knights
summary: Haido had led a group of medieval like knights to achieve his dream of conquering the world (or in the warlord's own words, creating a utopia free of war).

debut.movie: Naruto the Movie: Legend of the Stone of Gelel

name: Hanabi Rescue Team
summary: This was a highly specialised team from Konohagakure formed by the Sixth Hokage under the leadership of Shikamaru Nara. The team was tasked with rescuing Hanabi Hyūga — the Hyūga clan's heiress — after she was kidnapped by Toneri Ōtsutsuki. The team was also tasked in investigating Toneri's involvement with the falling moon and, if possible, avert the latter's plan and save the world.

debut.novel: The Last: Naruto the Movie

name: Haze Quadruplets
summary: They are quadruplet brothers hailing from the Land of Haze who specialise in Haze-Style kinjutsu. Orphaned at a young age, they were raised in an orphanage where they appreciated having a home at all to call their own, and such grew up to become very committed to serving their country. They have a rule that each abides to of always sharing everything equally amongst each other.

name: Hiruko's Team
summary: Sometime after defecting from Konoha, Hiruko assembled his own team. He trusted them enough to teach them his Chimera Technique. They are responsible for keeping unwanted outsiders from reaching Hiruko, protecting the perimeter of Mount Shumisen, as well as fighting those who reached the gates on the way to the mountain peak. When Hiruko tried to collect Kakashi's Sharingan, each of them fought in one gate; Ichi guarded the first gate, and fought Team Guy, Ni guarded the second gate, and fought Team Kurenai, and San guarded the third gate, and fought Team Asuma, with Hiruko welcoming Kakashi after the fourth gate. All three had a mark on their backs, similar to the mark on Hiruko's hand. San later summoned the recently defeated Ichi and Ni, and merged with them, forming a chimera beast, an union of the animals each controlled independently. After being restrained by Team Guy, Team Kurenai, and Team Asuma, it was summoned by Hiruko, and was subsequently destroyed by the combined efforts of the Konoha 11.

debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire

name: Hokage Guard Platoon
summary: This guard platoon is a group of Konohagakure shinobi dedicated towards the protection of the Hokage. The group has served as elite bodyguards for the Fourth Hokage, who in his reign, taught them how to use the Flying Thunder Formation Technique, a minor version of the Flying Thunder God Technique, but unlike that technique, required the cooperation of all three members of the team to perform it.

name: Honoured Siblings
summary: The Honoured Siblings are a pair of siblings highly revered throughout Sunagakure. Their renown is such that they have many connections with other villages, even ones which Sunagakure did not form alliances with. They have since retired from active duty due to old age, and disconnected themselves from the outside world.

debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire

name: Impure World Reincarnation Allied Forces
summary: The Impure World Reincarnation Allied Forces was a group of reincarnated shinobi from various countries, whose mission was to unseal the stronger shinobi, previously neutralised by the Allied Shinobi Forces. The majority of them were shinobi whose DNA Kabuto collected during his time serving Orochimaru, specifically for testing the Summoning: Impure World Reincarnation, and some were collected after Kabuto integrated Orochimaru's remains into himself.

name: Infiltration and Reconnaissance Party
summary: The Infiltration and Reconnaissance Party was an elite Konoha team led by Anko Mitarashi tasked with tracking down Kabuto Yakushi. During the course of their investigation, they located Akatsuki's base of operations, which they scouted for the Allied Shinobi Forces.

name: Ino–Saku–Sai
summary: Ino–Saku–Sai is a highly specialised team from Konoha, formed by the Sixth Hokage, under Ino Yamanaka's self-appointed leadership.

debut.novel: Sakura Hiden: Thoughts of Love, Riding Upon a Spring Breeze

name: Intelligence Division
summary: The Intelligence Division of the Allied Shinobi Forces was a group of shinobi grouped together because of their skill at information gathering to aid in the war against Akatsuki.

name: Ishi Terrorists
summary: The Ishi Terrorists were a group of missing-nin terrorists from Ishigakure that possessed a collection of kekkei genkai. They held no allegiance to any other hidden villages and instead worked for the highest bidder.

debut.novel: Gaara Hiden: A Sandstorm Mirage

name: Jako's Gang
summary: This gang was a group of thieves led by Jako. The gang was travelling with treasure stolen from the Fire Daimyō's sister. The treasure was later recovered by Naruto Uzumaki and Sasuke Uchiha, who later defeated the gang.

name: Janin
summary: The Janin were a trio of brothers with special ninjutsu.

name: Kaima Capture Team
summary: The Kaima Capture Team was a team assigned to escort a delivery ship and solve a sea monster mystery in the Land of the Sea.

name: Kanabun Gang
summary: This gang was led by its boss, Kanabun.

name: Kazekage Rescue Team
summary: The Kazekage Rescue Team is the primary joint Konoha-Sunagakure response team assigned to rescue the Fifth Kazekage from Akatsuki, anticipating pursuing the latter group, as well as facing Sasori. The addition of the highly experienced Chiyo, who also excelled in medical ninjutsu, to Team Kakashi raised the group's mission capabilities to a high level.

name: Kinkaku Force
summary: The Kinkaku Force was a special team of at least twenty highly skilled shinobi from Kumogakure.

name: Konoha 11
summary: The Konoha 11 is a term used to collectively refer to the members of four Konoha teams: Team 7, Team 8, Team 10, and Team Guy. Team 7's Sasuke Uchiha is not included in the group as he had defected from the village prior to its formation. Though the members appear in both the manga and anime and often work collectively in both medias, the term "Konoha 11" is only ever used in the anime.

debut.novel: Kakashi Hiden: Lightning in the Icy Sky
debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire
debut.ova: Hidden Leaf Village Grand Sports Festival!

name: Konoha Barrier Team
summary: Konoha's Barrier Team are in charge of maintaining the detection barrier surrounding Konoha, detecting intruders, and intercepting them. The team is led by members of the Yamanaka Clan.

debut.novel: Sasuke Shinden: Book of Sunrise

name: Konoha Council
summary: The Konoha Council exists to help the Hokage govern the village and to make sure all decisions are made with the best interest of Konoha and its inhabitants in mind.

name: Konoha Cryptanalysis Team
summary: The Konoha Cryptanalysis Team also known as the Konoha Cryptology Team is an organisation specialising in deciphering secret codes and messages, taking their orders directly from the Hokage. Their base of operation is located in a library-structured office. This facility possesses a desktop computer and numerous vertical files, presumably holding almost all of the secret codes Konohagakure uses in missions and message delivery. They work closely with the shinobi who oversee the Konoha Aviary.

name: Konoha Military Police Force

alternatives.name: Konohagakure Security Force
alternatives.kanji: 木ノ葉隠れの里の警備部隊
alternatives.romaji: Konohagakure no Sato no Keibi Butai

summary: The Konoha Military Police Force is — as the name suggests — the judicial organisation of Konohagakure. Initially believed to have been founded by the Uchiha, in actuality, it was founded by the Second Hokage, and was given to the Uchiha as a sign of trust and good faith between the Senju and themselves. Tobi believed, however, that this was just a method of ostracising them from the village: having built the police station next to a prison, as well as distancing the Uchiha from taking part in the actual governing of Konoha, with it believed the responsibility was essentially forced unto the Uchiha.

name: Konoha Special Mission Platoon
summary: The Konoha Special Mission Platoon is one of the many teams specially formed to carry out missions after the loss in manpower following the Konoha Crush. While returning to Konoha after a tiring mission, the team senses the Sound Four leaving the village. Genma and Raidō confront them, but are defeated. Shizune later finds them and provides emergency medical attention.

name: Konoha Torture and Interrogation Force

names.kanji: 木ノ葉拷問・尋問部隊

alternatives.name: Konoha Anbu Torture and Interrogation Force
alternatives.kanji: 木ノ葉暗部拷問・尋問部隊

alternatives.name: Konoha's Anbu Torture and Interrogation Force
alternatives.kanji: 木ノ葉の暗部拷問尋問部隊
alternatives.romaji: Konoha no Anbu Gomon Jinmon Butai

summary: The Konoha Torture and Interrogation Force is a special division within Konohagakure headed by Ibiki Morino. Their base of operations is located in the Konohagakure Intelligence Division.

debut.novel: Sakura Hiden: Thoughts of Love, Riding Upon a Spring Breeze

name: Kumo Barrier Team
summary: Kumo's Barrier Team was tasked with creating and maintaining the Self-Repairing Barrier technique around Genbu, preventing Killer B and Naruto Uzumaki from leaving it.

name: Kumo Council
summary: This council is an assembly presided over by the Raikage, consisting of Kumogakure's highest ranking and most prominent shinobi which gather to discuss strategy and tactics regarding the village.

name: Kumo Spectators
summary: Sekiei and Mikage were spectators from Kumogakure who were watching the final rounds of the Chūnin Exams. When the Konoha Crush by Suna and Oto began, they took the opportunity to kidnap Hinata Hyūga for her Byakugan. The Hyūga Elder tried to save her but they escaped before he was able to get to them. He was later knocked unconscious by an Otogakure ninja. Neji Hyūga, Tenten, and Kiba Inuzuka trailed the two ninja outside the village limits and Kiba rescued Hinata after she struck the short spectator. Neji, disguised as Kiba, had the Kumo ninja following him with a decoy Hinata while Kiba took Hinata to safety. After defeating the first ninja, Neji fights against Sekiei but struggles against his Earth Release technique that had bound both his hands and feet. Neji was saved by Hiashi Hyūga who subsequently defeats the ninja with the Eight Trigrams Vacuum Palm technique. After their defeat, they were captured and questioned.

name: Kurosuki Family
summary: The Kurosuki Family was a criminal gang that was formed by Raiga Kurosuki (one of the Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist) and Ranmaru.

name: Leaf's Anbu
summary: The Leaf's Anbu, formatted in-game in english version as "Leaf"'s Anbu, are led by Shinga. They are the main antagonists in Naruto Shippūden: Ultimate Ninja Heroes 3, with the goal to rule over the world.

name: Legendary Stupid Brothers
summary: The Legendary Stupid Brothers are a pair of criminal ninja who originate from an unknown village.

name: Lightning Group
summary: The Lightning Group was a group of disenfranchised shinobi, most of whom possessed a kekkei genkai. The group was first formed by Fūshin and other former slaves of En Oyashiro who, despite never having done anything wrong, had been abused and taken advantage of their entire lives. Fūshin and the others wanted to help those on the fringes of society in ways that nobody had ever helped them. The Lightning Group attacked murderers, thieves, and other wrong-doers and took everything they had. They then dispersing the plunder to those in need, primarily small settlements like Bamboo Village that were often neglected by their countries.

debut.novel: Sasuke Shinden: Book of Sunrise

name: Logistical Support and Medical Division
summary: The Logistical Support and Medical Division of the Allied Shinobi Forces was a group of medical-nin from five hidden villages that have been allied together in preparation for the Fourth Shinobi World War, which was led by Shizune. Each member bears a distinctive supply bag on their back.

name: Magaki Group
summary: The Magaki Group was a group of four bandit ninja led by Shiranami. Their objective was to steal a kinjutsu capable of wiping out an entire village from the Tsuchigumo clan. All the members of the group, apart from their leader, specialised in Cooperation Ninjutsu. The Magaki Group was later defeated by Team 7.

name: Medic Corps
summary: The Medic Corps or the Medical Team, also known as the Medic Division is a subdivision of Konohagakure's medical-nin organisation and hospital. These shinobi generally work at the hospital full-time, and their roles are similar to those of field medical-nin in that they are deployed to aid the comrades who are out on missions. However, unlike field medical-nin that normally get assigned to a four-man-team to serve in that capacity, they move as an independent team comprised solely of medical-nin.

name: Mezu Gang
summary: The Mezu Gang is a group of assassins formed by the missing-nin Mezu. Its members wore skeletal face paint. After their encounters with Mirai Sarutobi and Shikamaru Nara, the gang was subdued and taken into custody by the Sixth Hokage.

name: Mokuzu Gang
summary: This was a group of thieves from Mokuzu Island. They tried to steal valuables from the ship road upon by Naruto, Aoba, Guy, and Yamato, but with the help of Shikamaru and Tenten, they managed to defeat them.

name: Moya Triad
summary: The Moya Triad, or the Moya Brothers, are a trio of "ninja" (though they lack the skill of even the most feeble shinobi). Aniki, the eldest brother, serves as their leader. They each have a stylised haze cloud symbol on their forehead protectors that almost resembles a question mark. They claim that they are very wealthy.

name: Mujina Bandits
summary: The Mujina Bandits are an international criminal group of missing-nin from varying shinobi villages, all under the leadership of Shojoji.

debut.novel: Shikamaru Shinden: A Cloud Dancing in Forlorn Falling Petals (Mentioned)

name: New Seven Ninja Swordsmen
summary: The New Seven Ninja Swordsmen were the self-proclaimed successors of the original Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist. Formed by Shizuma Hoshigaki, the group's objective was to start a coup d'état in Kirigakure to overthrow the Sixth Mizukage and replace him with Kagura Karatachi, as well as return the village to the era of the "Bloody Mist".

debut.novel: School Trip Bloodwind Records

name: Nokizaru Group
summary: The Nokizaru Group is a mercenary ninja organisation comprised of shinobi who are hired to hunt and assassinate other shinobi. They hold no allegiance to any country or village and were proficient in the use of the Exploding Insect technique, and also showed skill in concealment, mostly through camouflage, hiding in shadows, water and even fire, and spying techniques such as linking themselves to bugs. All members of this group were depicted as wearing sashes that resembled the tails of monkeys. They also had painted faces and wore outfits that had stripes on one side, while the other was a solid colour.

name: Peddlers Escort Team
summary: The Peddlers Escort Team was a genin team, assigned to escort a group of merchants from the Land of Vegetables.

name: Prajñā Group
summary: The Prajñā Group is a regiment of the Anbu of the Land of Woods.

name: Puppet Brigade
summary: The Puppet Brigade was an organisation in Sunagakure active during at least the Second Shinobi World War, presumably composed of Suna's elite puppeteers. Sasori created many puppets that were used by the brigade.

name: Ryūha Armament Alliance
summary: The Ryūha Armament Alliance is an organisation formed in the Land of Waves after the Fourth Shinobi World War. Following the example set by Madara Uchiha, the Armament Alliance seeks to free the world from the corruptive influence of money. Its members are primarily missing-nin.

debut.novel: Kakashi Hiden: Lightning in the Icy Sky

name: Sasuke Recovery Team
summary: The Sasuke Recovery Team was an emergency-response team formed with the purpose of stopping Sasuke Uchiha from defecting to Otogakure.

debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire
debut.ova: Naruto Shippūden: UNSG anime cutscenes

name: Scientific Ninja Weapons Team
summary: The Scientific Ninja Weapons Team is a subdivision of Konohagakure's ninja weapons organisation. Their field of work involves Scientific Ninja Tools.

debut.novel: Boruto: Naruto the Movie
debut.game: Naruto x Boruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm Connections

name: Sea Route of Silence Gang
summary: These pirates use unusual tactics to attack ships and acquire any treasures they might possess.

name: Sealing Team

images.caption: Members of the Fourth Division's Sealing Team.

summary: Within each division of the Allied Shinobi Forces there was a team of shinobi with the express purpose of capturing the reincarnated individuals used by the opposition. The shinobi that composed these teams were predominantly from Sunagakure and are capable of using the Cloth Binding Technique. After the target has been bound, seals are then applied to the bindings in order to prevent Kabuto Yakushi from retrieving them and then simply re-deploying them to the battlefield.

name: Second Division
summary: The Second Division, also known as the Short-Range Battle Division, was a battalion in the Allied Shinobi Forces led by Kitsuchi of Iwagakure, formed in preparation for the Fourth Shinobi World War.

name: Sensor Division
summary: The Sensor Division was comprised of ninja with high sensory abilities in the Allied Shinobi Forces to aid in the war against Akatsuki.

name: Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist

names.english: Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist

summary: The Seven Ninja Swordsmen of the Mist was an organisation consisting of only the greatest blade-wielding shinobi of their generation that Kirigakure can produce. There can only be seven members at a time — hence the name. The swords of the Seven Swordsmen are passed down from generation to generation since the First Mizukage's era. Those that could wield the seven mystical blades which chose their own wielders became known as the the Seven Swordsmen, and together, they are capable of bringing down an entire nation, regarded as being the strongest shinobi in the village behind the Mizukage, with the role being passed on to the strongest swordsman in tradition. In their history, they had engaged in deadly battles against shinobi from various countries.

debut.novel: School Trip Bloodwind Records (Mentioned)

name: Shin Uchiha (Clones)
summary: Shin Uchiha is the name given to the various individual genetic clones of the original Shin Uchiha, who treats them both as sons and organ donors.

debut.novel: Konoha Shinden: Steam Ninja Scrolls (Mentioned)

name: Shinobazu
summary: The Shinobazu were a group of missing-nin who left their ninja villages and serve themselves. The Shinobazu operated in the Land of Forests, with their hideout located in the Forest of Bewilderment. They attacked various families and households, killing everyone to prevent survivors from seeking revenge. This was prevented by Gantetsu's actions of rescuing the orphans and hiding them, taking care of them with his cut of the funds. Shura then became the acting leader of the group.

name: Shirogane Three
summary: The Shirogane Three was a three-man cell led by Ibushi of the Shirogane clan.

name: Sound Four
summary: The Sound Four was an Otogakure team that served as Orochimaru's elite bodyguards. Despite the name, there are technically five members because Sakon and Ukon share positions.

debut.ova: Finally a clash! Jōnin vs. Genin!! Indiscriminate Grand Melee Tournament Meeting!!

name: Star Guard Team
summary: The Star Guard Team was a genin team, assigned to protect the precious chakra-emitting star (which was actually a meteorite), located in Hoshigakure, from thieves.

name: Suicide Corps
summary: The Suicide Corps is a team of Konohagakure taijutsu users under the leadership of Rock Lee. All of the members of the group seem to be exceptionally skilled in taijutsu, demonstrating enough mastery of the Eight Gates to access the Sixth Gate for a team attack. Two years after the Fourth Shinobi World War, the team defended Konoha from falling meteorites.

debut.novel: The Last: Naruto the Movie

name: Sumo Wrestlers
summary: The Sumo Wrestlers are a group of sumo wrestlers that go around attacking shinobi and samurai alike. Their leader is Yokozuna. As sumo wrestlers, they rely on their brutal strength in fights using open-handed slaps. They attempted to overtake Konohagakure, but were unsuccessful after being driven out by the Allied Mothers Force and Konohamaru.

name: Suna Council
summary: The Suna Council exists to help the Kazekage govern the village and to make sure all decisions are made with the best interest of the village and its inhabitants in mind. The council seems to consist of 12 members, more commonly known as "Seniors". Their discussions occur in the Kazekage's Office, in the room where the statues of all the Kazekage reside.

debut.novel: Gaara Hiden: A Sandstorm Mirage

name: Surprise Attack Division
summary: The Surprise Attack Division of the Allied Shinobi Forces was a group of shinobi that were placed together as a battalion because of their skills at ambush attacks. They were led by Kankurō.

name: Surprise Attack and Diversion Platoon
summary: The Akatsuki Surprise Attack and Diversion Platoon was formed by Kabuto Yakushi during the outset of the Fourth Shinobi World War. The primary goal of the squad was to conduct an air raid on the Allied Shinobi Forces. The members were all reincarnated by Kabuto using the Summoning: Impure World Reincarnation technique.

name: Taka
summary: Taka, originally Hebi, was a team created by Sasuke Uchiha with the initial objective of locating Itachi Uchiha, and preventing anyone from interrupting Sasuke's battle with him.

debut.novel: Naruto Jinraiden: The Day the Wolf Howled
debut.ova: Naruto Shippūden: UNSG anime cutscenes

name: Team 10 (Moegi)
summary: Team 10, also known as Team Moegi, is a Konohagakure team formed under the leadership of Moegi Kazamatsuri. The team is comprised of the 17th and most recent generation of the Ino–Shika–Chō trio: Inojin Yamanaka, Shikadai Nara and Chōchō Akimichi.

debut.novel: Boruto: Naruto the Movie

name: Team 15
summary: Team 15 is a shinobi team from Konohagakure, led by Hanabi Hyūga, consisting of Sumire Kakei, Wasabi Izuno, and Namida Suzumeno. In the anime, after Sumire resigned from Team 15 to join the Scientific Ninja Weapons Team, she was replaced by Tsubaki Kurogane, making Team 15 the first official shinobi team to include a samurai.

debut.novel: The Last Day at the Ninja Academy!

name: Team 2
summary: Team 2 was a team of Konohagakure genin led by Yūki Minazuki.

debut.novel: Itachi Shinden: Book of Bright Light

name: Team 25
summary: Team 25 is a shinobi team from Konohagakure, consisting of Hōki Taketori, Hako Kuroi, Renga Kokubō, and formerly an unknown shinobi. Sai Yamanaka was later appointed as the team's new leader when the team's former leader was taken off duty due to disabilities. He considers the genin's abilities particularly suited for intelligence missions. As such, he had them often assigned to Anbu missions and trained as such. Following Hōki's chūnin promotion, he was appointed as team captain as Team 25 became a three-person team.

debut.novel: The Last Day at the Ninja Academy!

name: Team 40
summary: Team 40 is a shinobi team from Konohagakure, consisting of Enko Onikuma, Dōshu Goetsu and Tsuru Itoi, as well as an unknown team leader. The team participated in the Chūnin Exams, but failed the first task, resulting in their elimination. After their original jōnin leader was incapacitated due to Enko's uncontrolled technique, the team leader was replaced by Ibiki Morino.

debut.novel: The Last Day at the Ninja Academy!

name: Team 5
summary: Team 5 is a shinobi team from Konohagakure, which is led by Udon Ise. Its members consist of: Metal Lee, Denki Kaminarimon and Iwabee Yuino. The team participated in the Chūnin Exams, but were eliminated in the second round by Team Shinki. Following Denki's chūnin promotion in the following exam, he was appointed as team captain as Team 5 became a three-person team.

debut.novel: The Last Day at the Ninja Academy!

name: Team 8
summary: Team Kurenai, also known as Team 8, was a ninja team led by Kurenai Yūhi. Its members are Kiba Inuzuka, his ninken Akamaru, Hinata Hyūga, and Shino Aburame. The team specialises in tracking and locating through the use of the Hyūga clan's Byakugan, the Aburame clan's bugs, and the Inuzuka clan's dogs as well as Kiba's own heightened sense of smell. When Kurenai became pregnant in Part II, Kakashi Hatake took over as the squad leader on some of their missions.

debut.novel: Kakashi Hiden: Lightning in the Icy Sky
debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire
debut.ova: Hidden Leaf Village Grand Sports Festival!

name: Team 9
summary: Team 9 is a shinobi team from Konohagakure. After graduating a year before Boruto's class, this team is normally away from village as they accept missions overseas. After the invasion of Isshiki Ōtsutsuki, Team 9 returned to Konoha to participate in the new Chūnin Exams. None of them made it to the final exam.

name: Team Ajisai
summary: This is a kunoichi team from Amegakure, originally consisting of Ajisai, Suiren, and Fuyō. The team participated in the Konoha-Suna joint Chūnin Exams where Konan tasked them with finding jinchūriki and if that failed, gathering intel on the strength of the shinobi from the other villages.

name: Team Ameno
summary: This is a genin team from Sunagakure, consisting of Ameno, Kōji, and Shishio. The team travelled to Konoha to participate in the Konoha-Suna joint Chūnin Exams. After the team passed the first round of the exam, they raced to the Demon Desert in the Land of Wind where the second stage of the exam was being held.

name: Team 10 (Asuma)
summary: Team Asuma, also known as Team 10, is a generation in the Ino–Shika–Chō Trio. As such, the three team members are good friends and have exceptional team work, although they tend to bicker from time to time. All three members of Team 10 are skilled at stalling opponents and excel at coordinated jutsu attacks, with their ability as a four-man squad being raised even higher by the time of Part II with Shikamaru's improved tactics and Ino's newfound medical ninjutsu and improved detection skills. They were led by Asuma until his death in Part II. Kakashi led them temporarily after that to help them avenge Asuma's death. The team is assumed to still be active, although without a permanent leader.

debut.novel: Kakashi Hiden: Lightning in the Icy Sky
debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire
debut.ova: Hidden Leaf Village Grand Sports Festival!

name: Team Bandō
summary: This is a team of shinobi from Benisu Island. They are first seen when they are encountered by Naruto Uzumaki, Sakura Haruno, Ino Yamanaka and Chōji Akimichi on Nanakusa Island. At this time, the four Konohagakure ninja are attempting to collect ingredients (for medical purposes) for Tsunade. Team Bandō interferes with the latter's ingredient collecting (including medicinal herbs and red newts, although they first claim to only be after medicinal herbs and they don't mention the red newts) saying that they need them to protect themselves (a minor country) during the upcoming war. The three are all skilled with their abacuses, using them as skateboards, and are skilled enough with them to slide across a plain of geysers with randomly erupting toxic gas and reach the other side unharmed. Bandō, the supposed leader of the trio, was able to decipher a safe path after watching Naruto's shadow clones run through the field in an attempt to reach the other side. The other two members also seemed to know the path that Bandō figured out since they followed him, but it is possible that they were simply just following him.

name: Team Chōza
summary: This was a genin team from Konohagakure that consisted of Might Guy, Genma Shiranui and Ebisu. In the anime, the team was led by Chōza Akimichi.

name: Team Dosu
summary: This team was one of the three groups Orochimaru included in his plan to infiltrate the Chūnin Exams in Konoha. While this team entered the exams as genin representing Otogakure, another team posed as Konoha-nin, and Orochimaru himself assumed the identity of another. Accordingly, due to various modifications, all three members used sound-based techniques. The team leader is Dosu Kinuta with Kin Tsuchi and Zaku Abumi as his teammates.

name: Team Ebisu
summary: This is a team from Konohagakure, led by Ebisu. Its members consists of Konohamaru Sarutobi, Udon and Moegi. It was formed during the time-skip between Part I and Part II.

debut.ova: Chūnin Exam on Fire! Naruto vs. Konohamaru!

name: Team Fū
summary: This was a team establised by Shibuki from Takigakure, consisting of Taki's jinchūriki Fū and two jōnin, Kegon and Yōrō, who disguised themselves as genin to protect Fū during the joint Konoha and Suna Chūnin Exams, with the intention of also trying to hide her status as a jinchūriki.

name: Team Ganryū
summary: Team Ganryū was a team led by Ganryū ten years prior to the formation of the Allied Shinobi Forces. With the assistance of Iwagakure, they were sent on a mission to retrieve a document taken by Kumogakure from Kirigakure. However, when the document was retrieved, the Iwagakure shinobi betrayed the Kiri team and killed Junsai and Suiren, where the latter sacrificed herself to save Ganryū. This incident would become known as the Tragedy of Yosuga Pass which began the hostilities between the two nations.

name: Team Goji
summary: This is a genin team from Sunagakure, which consisted of Goji, Datsuji and an unnamed teammate. The team participated in the joint Chūnin Exams. During the second phase, the team betrays Team Shira and attacks them. However, Team Guy intervenes and manages to defeat them. As a result, the team hands over a scroll to both teams.

name: Team Guren
summary: This is a team formed upon Orochimaru's orders to capture the Three-Tails. They were chosen from the best of the initial twenty-one prisoners that survived a battle royal, which Guren had organised; sixteen of them tried to rebel afterwards, however, Guren killed them. Guren leads the remaining five and Yūkimaru on a mission to capture the beast. Their efforts are repeatedly interrupted by the shinobi from Konohagakure. After four of the members are killed and Guren realises that Orochimaru has little concern for her, she defects with Yūkimaru and Gozu.

name: Team Guy
summary: Team Guy was a team led by Might Guy and was formed a year before the other main Konoha teams of the series. They specialise in close-quarters combat with all of its members using some sort of physical attacks. Their coordination therein makes them unmatched in hand-to-hand combat. Guy waited a year before entering them in the Chūnin Exams, though none of his apprentices were promoted at that time.

debut.novel: Kakashi Hiden: Lightning in the Icy Sky
debut.ova: Hidden Leaf Village Grand Sports Festival!

name: Team Kabuto
summary: This team, disguised as Konohagakure genin-levelled shinobi, were Otogakure spies that took part in the Chūnin Exams to observe Sasuke Uchiha for Orochimaru. Kabuto proved most successful in this goal, but withdrew from the exams before the preliminary matches. Testing Sasuke's mettle was left to Yoroi Akadō, who was defeated by Sasuke in the first preliminary match. Misumi Tsurugi was later defeated by his opponent as well.

name: Team Kajika
summary: Team Kajika is the team of antagonists from Naruto: The Cross Roads. It consisted of Kajika, the leader, Iwana and Yamame. They were loyal to Orochimaru.

debut.ova: Naruto: The Cross Roads

name: Team 7 (Kakashi)
summary: Team 7 was a Konohagakure team formed under the leadership of Kakashi Hatake. Two-and-a-half years after Sasuke Uchiha left the village, Kakashi filled out paperwork to form Team Kakashi, with his former pupils Naruto Uzumaki and Sakura Haruno now being treated as equals alongside their teacher. Following Yamato and Sai joining the team, the group went by Team Yamato during the former's leadership.

debut.novel: Naruto: Innocent Heart, Demonic Blood
debut.movie: Naruto the Movie: Ninja Clash in the Land of Snow
debut.ova: Find the Four-Leaf Red Clover!

name: Team Kazami
summary: This was a genin team from Kusagakure, consisting of Kazami, Burami, and Muyami. The team participated in the joint Konoha-Suna Chūnin Exams. According to Kazami, this team specialises in obtaining a targeted item from the enemy territory and bringing it home without fail.

name: Team Komugi
summary: This team was one of the many genin teams that participated in the Chūnin Exams that were held in Konohagakure. During the written portion, Komugi, afraid of the tenth question, dropped out, which led his teammates, Gennai and Inaho, to be disqualified.

name: Team Matsuri
summary: This is a genin team from Sunagakure consisting of Matsuri, Yukata and Mikoshi. Their files were briefly shown being read by Gaara, before he submitted the recommendations for the joint Chūnin Exams with Konohagakure.

name: Team Minato
summary: Team Minato was a team led by Minato Namikaze and composed of Kakashi Hatake, Obito Uchiha, and Rin Nohara.

debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire
debut.ova: Naruto Shippūden: UNSG anime cutscenes

name: Team Oboro
summary: Team Oboro was one of the genin teams participating in the Chūnin Exams. They did not pass the second test of the exam, being defeated by Team 7 and Kabuto Yakushi. The team is seen again in the anime under the leadership of Aoi Rokushō. They try to prevent Idate Morino from completing a race in the Land of Tea, but are stopped again by Team 7; Naruto Uzumaki used an application of the first step of his Rasengan training to create a whirlpool that sucked Team Oboro into a trench. Since it is likely their masks let them breathe underwater, it is assumed they survived.

debut.ova: Hidden Leaf Village Grand Sports Festival!

name: Team Orochimaru
summary: This was a genin team led by the Sannin Orochimaru. Its members were Anko Mitarashi, an unnamed shinobi who would eventually become the leader of a team of spies for Orochimaru, and another unnamed shinobi with long, brown hair tied in a ponytail.

name: Team Ro
summary: Team Ro is an elite Anbu unit of Konohagakure that serves directly under the Hokage.

debut.novel: Itachi Shinden: Book of Dark Night

name: Team Sajin
summary: This is a genin team from Sunagakure, consisting of Sajin, Mujin and Mijin. The team participated in the Konoha-Suna joint Chūnin Exams, but did not qualify for the second phase, due to choosing to eliminate a member (Mijin) from their ranks in the first phase.

name: Team Samui
summary: This is a team hailed from Kumogakure. The Fourth Raikage sent them to Konohagakure to inform the Hokage that he will deal with Sasuke Uchiha after the latter was accused of kidnapping B — the village's jinchūriki, and to gather all of Konoha's information about Sasuke and the Akatsuki.

name: Team Saya
summary: This is a genin team from Sunagakure, consisting of Saya, Mamushi, and Sana. The team participated in the joint Konoha-Suna Chūnin Exams.

name: Team Shibire
summary: This was a genin from Konohagakure, which consisted of Minoji, Shibire, and Tanzō. The team participated in the Chūnin Exams, making it to the second stage, but didn't pass due to Minoji and Shibire opening their scroll early on while Tanzō was absent, resulting in them being knocked out by summoned Konoha shinobi.

name: Team Shigeri
summary: This was a team from Kusagakure, which consisted of Karin, Shigeri and an unnamed male teammate. Karin's healing ability proved to be beneficial enough that her weaker teammates would often take advantage of her for it.

name: Team Shigure
summary: This was one of the genin teams participating in the Chūnin Exams. An elite team that came from Amegakure, led by Shigure, all members wield umbrellas and wear oxygen tanks. They had the unfortunate circumstance of meeting the Three Sand Siblings in the second phase. They unwittingly confronted and provoked Gaara, who killed them all quickly and mercilessly.

name: Team Shinki
summary: This chūnin team from Sunagakure consists of Shinki, the adopted child of the Fifth Kazekage Gaara, as well as two other Suna shinobi, Araya and Yodo.

debut.novel: Boruto: Naruto the Movie

name: Team Shiore
summary: This was a genin team of Kusagakure who entered the Chūnin exams. However, prior to the exams, the team were murdered by the Sound Four and Orochimaru (Sound Five in the anime), with the Oto-nin then used a ninjutsu to assume their identities to get access to Sasuke Uchiha. Their bodies were found faceless later by Izumo Kamizuki, Kotetsu Hagane, and Mozuku, who alerted Anko Mitarashi immediately upon discovery to identify them. By the time their corpses were found, Orochimaru’s mission was fulfilled. The team did not pass the second stage of the exams, and Orochimaru instead changed his guise to the leader of Team Dosu afterwards.

name: Team Shira
summary: This was a genin team from Sunagakure, consisting of Shira, Yome, and Sen. The team participated in the Konoha-Suna joint Chūnin Exams. While the team wasn't able to gather both needed scrolls in the second stage of the exam, a sudden change in the regulations renewed the possibility for them to become chūnin. While Shira actually got promoted, it is unknown if this also applied to Yome and Sen.

name: Team Shisui
summary: Team Shisui was a ninja team led by Shisui Uchiha.

name: Team Suien
summary: Team Suien is the team of antagonists from the second Naruto OVA Mission: Protect the Waterfall Village! It consists of Suien, the leader, who is a missing-nin of Takigakure and three other missing-nin from Amegakure: Kirisame, Murasame, and Hisame. There were also nine unnamed footsoldiers.

debut.novel: Naruto: Mission: Protect The Waterfall Village! (novel)
debut.ova: Mission: Protect the Waterfall Village!

name: Team Tobirama
summary: Team Tobirama was a team led by the future Second Hokage, Tobirama Senju, disciples of him and his brother. It was comprised of himself, Hiruzen Sarutobi, Homura Mitokado, and Koharu Utatane. Very little is known of the team, but on occasion during the First Shinobi World War, they teamed up with Danzō Shimura, Kagami Uchiha and Torifu Akimichi to carry out a mission as the Second Hokage's elite Escort Unit.

name: Orochimaru Search Team
summary: The Orochimaru Search Team is sent to investigate one of Orochimaru's bases. Originally composed of Kakashi Hatake and the members of Team 8, it is reinforced twice: first, the remaining members of Team 7 are sent to help with Team Guren, and then several miscellaneous Konoha personnel are sent to help seal the Three-Tails.

name: Team Yurui
summary: This genin team from Kumogakure participates in the Chūnin Exams held in Konohagakure. After progressing to the exams' final stage, they are defeated by Team Konohamaru; Yurui is defeated by Boruto Uzumaki, Tarui by Sarada Uchiha, and Toroi by Mitsuki.

debut.novel: Boruto: Naruto the Movie

name: Third Division
summary: The Third Division, also known as the Short and Mid-Range Battle Division, was a battalion in the Allied Shinobi Forces led by Kakashi Hatake of Konohagakure, formed for the Fourth Shinobi World War.

name: Three Brothers
summary: The Three Brothers is a team from Iwagakure that chased down Kosuke Maruboshi in an attempt to retrieve valuable information that he had stolen from them. Their efforts were, however, thwarted by Team Asuma using their Formation Ino–Shika–Chō.

name: Three Ryūdōin Brothers
summary: The Three Ryūdōin Brothers were introduced in the anime. They seek revenge on Might Guy for their father's humiliation and death. They manipulated wooden dummies to attack Guy, which failed due to Guy's great taijutsu skills. It is then revealed that Guy had great respect for their father. Guy said that their father was a great and brave man who wished to fight Guy again one day. The brothers all feel like they misinterpreted their father's departing words.

name: Three Sand Siblings
summary: The Three Sand Siblings is the collective name for the children of Sunagakure's Fourth Kazekage: Temari, Kankurō and Gaara. Having undergone the gruelling training of their village, these three are regarded as elite shinobi of their village that excel in long-range combat.

debut.novel: Gaara Hiden: A Sandstorm Mirage
debut.ova: Finally a clash! Jōnin vs. Genin!! Indiscriminate Grand Melee Tournament Meeting!!

name: Three Senka Brothers
summary: The Three Senka Brothers are a set of triplets that make up a Kirigakure genin team.

name: Thundercloud Unit
summary: The Thundercloud Unit is a special backup unit, belonging to the Supply Unit of the Allied Shinobi Forces from Kumogakure. It is composed of seven members who are well versed in several areas of bukijutsu, especially kenjutsu, formed by twelve to thirteen years old kids. Despite their young age, they were considered prodigies in their village which earned them a place in the war.

name: Twelve Guardian Ninja
summary: The Twelve Guardian Ninja were the bodyguards of the Land of Fire's daimyō. Membership is indicated by the waistcloth they wear, marked with the kanji for "Fire".

debut.novel: Itachi Shinden: Book of Bright Light

name: Twenty Platoons
summary: The Twenty Platoons are a task force created by the Fifth Hokage consisting of twenty four-man teams. Their mission is to scour the Land of Fire in search of members of Akatsuki. The Akatsuki members are to be captured alive, but if that is not possible they are to be eliminated.

name: Two Great Sage Toads
summary: Two Great Sage Toads is the collective name given to Fukasaku and Shima - two toads from Mount Myōboku, who rank immediately under the Great Toad Sage.

name: Wandering Ninja Clan
summary: The Wandering Ninja Clan were mercenaries who appeared in Naruto the Movie: Guardians of the Crescent Moon Kingdom.

debut.movie: Naruto the Movie: Guardians of the Crescent Moon Kingdom

name: Watari Ninja
summary: The Watari Ninja are a small group of missing-nin led by Hōki. Most of the members wear masks to hide their identities.

name: White Zetsu Army

names.literal: The One Hundred Thousand White Zetsu

summary: The White Zetsu Army was a large attack force that was created by Kaguya Ōtsutsuki, who desired living weapons to combat other members of the Ōtsutsuki clan. One hundred thousand White Zetsu made up the majority of Akatsuki's military numbers during the Fourth Shinobi World War.

debut.novel: Sasuke Shinden: Book of Sunrise
debut.movie: Road to Ninja: Naruto the Movie

name: Wind Release Team
summary: The Wind Release Team is a subdivision of the Fourth Division of the Allied Shinobi Forces. Lead by Temari, it consists of skilled Wind Release users, mainly equipped with Giant Folding Fans. The team has several battle formations, one of which (Formation C) is the collective use of the Wind Release: Cast Net technique. This team fought the Third Raikage, whose tough body was able to withstand all of their attacks.

name: Akatsuki
summary: Akatsuki was a group of shinobi that existed outside the usual system of the hidden villages. Over the course of several decades, Akatsuki took different forms and was led by different individuals. Though each iteration is viewed as either subversives or criminals, all sought to make the world a better place through their own means. Each Akatsuki tended to have multiple lairs across the world, inaccessible either due to their remoteness or the various security measures that protected them.

debut.novel: Akatsuki Hiden: Evil Flowers in Full Bloom
debut.movie: Road to Ninja: Naruto the Movie
debut.ova: Hidden Leaf Village Grand Sports Festival!

characters.name: Demonic Statue of the Outer Path

name: Allied Shinobi Forces
summary: The Allied Shinobi Forces was a coalition between the collective military might of the shinobi nations of the Lands of Lightning, Water, Earth, Wind, and Fire, and the lone samurai nation of the Land of Iron.

name: Cultural Institute
summary: The Cultural Institute is a large research bureau located in the Land of Stairs, developing various devices to help make people's lives easier. It was led by Furie Kanhen, before his arrest by the Seventh Hokage, due to Furie's selfish plans to monopolise the resource market. The Institute has several different departments, one of which is led by Noto Chōmen, and is similar in concept to the Institute for the Advanced Technology Research Institute, with which they finance a warehouse of flying ships in the Land of Fire.

debut.novel: Naruto Retsuden: Naruto Uzumaki and the Spiral Destiny

name: Earth Release Team
summary: The Earth Release Team was a subdivision of the First Division of the Allied Shinobi Forces. Lead by an Iwagakure shinobi, it consisted of skilled Earth Release users, seen when they used stone walls strong enough to trap and finally overwhelm Kinkaku in his six-tailed form with the assistance of Darui for a short time.

name: Fire Release Team
summary: The Fire Release Team was a subdivision of the First Division of the Allied Shinobi Forces. Lead by a Konohagakure shinobi, it consisted of skilled Fire Release users, seen when they used fire streams simultaneously, strong enough to bother Kinkaku in his six-tailed form for a short time.

name: Ino–Shika–Chō (15th)

names.kanji: いの しか ちょうトリオ

summary: The fifteenth generation of Ino-Shika-Chō consisted of Shikaku Nara, Inoichi Yamanaka and Chōza Akimichi, the fathers of Team Asuma. They teamed up in their younger days and continued working together even after passing the torch to their children.

debut.ova: Hidden Leaf Village Grand Sports Festival!

name: Iwa Council
summary: This council is an assembly of Iwagakure's elders and more prominent figures made in order to finalise decisions concerning their village. The council has convened to discuss matters such as peace treaties during the Third Shinobi World War and their village's participation in the combined Chūnin Exams.

name: Kaminarimon Company
summary: The Kaminarimon Company is a company that operates from its headquarters in Konohagakure. Regarded as the biggest enterprise in the land, its president Ereki Kaminarimon credits his achievements as a shinobi during the Fourth Shinobi World War for his company's success. This company makes Thunder Trains. It is also in charge of digitizing and archiving Konoha's entire background of its history, citizens, as well as creations and other achievements.

debut.novel: The New Leaves Soaring Through the Blue Sky! (Mentioned only)

name: Kaneki Corporation

names.kanji: カネキコーポレーション

summary: The Kaneki Corporation in a company that rivals the Kaminarimon Company in status. In order to remain competitive, its leaders pushed forward the development of a project in a chemical plant that resulted in an explosion that killed many people. The higher-ups successfully pinned the blame on the deceased project developer, Mikazuki Amaashi, destroying her reputation and avoiding being investigated. Years later, people involved in the accident were targeted and killed by Mikazuki's brother, Samidare. While he failed to kill the corporation's president, his involvement brought up new charges against the corporation, leading to the investigation being reopened.

name: Kara
summary: Kara is a secret society formerly led by Isshiki Ōtsutsuki, and later by Code.

name: Naruto's Fan Girls

names.kanji: ナルトファンのくノ一

summary: Naruto's Fan Girls is a group of young kunoichi who not only idolise, but are also infatuated with Naruto Uzumaki. Two years after the Fourth Shinobi World War, Naruto also had acquired a ridiculously huge fan base among young women from the hidden villages throughout the world. Later, the three kunoichi from Konohagakure were among the guests in attendance at Naruto and Hinata's wedding, congratulating their hero.

debut.novel: The Last: Naruto the Movie

name: Puppet Ninja Force
summary: The Puppet Ninja Force is an army of puppets created by Mukade.

debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Lost Tower

name: Root
summary: Root was a branch of Konohagakure's Anbu training subdivision. It was disbanded after the death of its founder, Danzō Shimura.

name: Sannin
summary: The Sannin were three renowned ninja from Konohagakure, hailed as the greatest of their time.

debut.novel: Sasuke Shinden: Book of Sunrise
debut.movie: Naruto Shippūden the Movie: The Will of Fire

name: Shinobi Union
summary: The Shinobi Union is the successor to the Allied Shinobi Forces.

debut.novel: Shikamaru Hiden: A Cloud Drifting in Silent Darkness

name: Suna Exploration Group
summary: The Suna Exploration Group is in charge of maintaining the detection barrier surrounding Sunagakure and the Demon Desert, detecting intruders and intercepting them.

name: Taki Kunoichi
summary: This group of kunoichi are spies from Takigakure. Initially the group had four members, but they lost a member that apparently had been gathering intel during a battle. This deceased member managed to hide gathered intel on Konoha's border patrol procedure on a kunai attached to a bird's nest. They possessed some skill, possessing multiple shuriken oriented techniques, wielded swords and had enough skill in nature transformation to perform a cooperation Fire Release technique.

name: Team 6
summary: This was a shinobi team of Konohagakure led by Jiraiya. It consisted of Minato Namikaze, who Jiraiya took special interest in on the belief that he could be the Child of the Prophecy, Dekai, and an unnamed individual. Minato would later become the Fourth Hokage.

debut.game: Naruto Shippūden: Ultimate Ninja Storm Generations
debut.ova: Naruto Shippūden: UNSG anime cutscenes

name: Team 7 (Konohamaru)
summary: Team Konohamaru is a shinobi cell from Konohagakure, led by Konohamaru Sarutobi.

debut.novel: Boruto: Naruto the Movie
debut.ova: Boruto OVA

name: Team Iwato
summary: This was a team from Yugakure, tasked with delivering a scroll containing secret data. The village leadership knew about the presence of a traitor among the team, but did not know who it was, so one of the team received a second scroll to confuse the traitors.

name: Water Attack Raid Unit
summary: The Water Attack Raid Unit is a sub-division of the Allied Shinobi Forces. It is mainly made up of shinobi from Kirigakure.

name: Water Release Team
summary: The Water Release Team is a subdivision of the First Division of the Allied Shinobi Forces. Lead by a shinobi from Kirigakure, the team consists of skilled Water Release users, which is seen when they used a giant version of the Water Release: Water Fang Bullet technique simultaneously, powerful enough to force Kinkaku in his six-tailed form to evade the attacks.

name: Zero
summary: Zero was an organisation led by Merz in Naruto x Boruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm Connections.

debut.game: Naruto x Boruto: Ultimate Ninja Storm Connections
